decisions.reason: As a core-adjacent express service the firm has some incentive to persist, but the lower public visibility and likely lower sunk investment make it more droppable than the more prominently backed launches.

Management is still likely to continue this closely related fast-delivery offer for now, though its limited public commitment and operational intensity make it the most vulnerable if early results disappoint.
This prominently launched, certified fire-resistant exterior door reflects clear technical investment and public commitment, which under escalation of commitment strongly favors retaining it.
A dedicated page and multiple-model line signal meaningful investment and visible commitment, so management would be reluctant to withdraw it quickly despite any early difficulties.
The digital platform fits the firm's stated move toward deeper advisory and service support and likely required substantial development effort, making continuation the more likely choice.

Because this safety-related door stays close to the firm's established strengths and can still be justified as part of a broader compliance-focused portfolio, management would more likely keep than drop it.
